comment: Single source of truth for ACCEPTED / known divergences from real PlantUML jar SVG output, for the svg-conformance golden suite (T6). Mirrors dot-engine's test/corpus/accepted-divergences.json schema (see that project's PARITY.md for the dashboard/rules-gate consumption pattern this is designed to slot into). An accepted entry is a deliberate, maintainer-signed, won't-fix difference; everything non-conformant NOT listed here is an unaccepted gap the emitter is expected to close. match: {id} exact | {idPattern} glob. scope: describes which gate the entry applies to. `retired` holds entries that were accepted and later withdrawn, kept so the reversal is auditable rather than silent; a retired entry is NOT in force. `surveyBlind` (optional string) marks an entry whose divergence the survey comparator deliberately cannot see; it must name the exemption. The ledger gate fails on any in-force entry the survey records as conformant unless it carries `surveyBlind`.

entries.scope: svg-conformance class ledger (ELK layout -- unsupported engine, DIVERGENCES.md)
entries.reason: `!pragma layout elk` is ruled unsupported (DIVERGENCES.md, `!pragma layout elk` -- not supported: one layout engine by choice, extending the 2026-08-09 ruling). The fixture lays out with @knowvah/dot-engine and will not match the Eclipse Layout Kernel geometry. Verified 2026-09-21: `in.puml` carries the pragma and there is no svek-N.dot dump for this slug in test-results/dot-cache/class/, so the jar never shelled out to graphviz and DOT parity has no oracle (oracleBlind). Declared, not special-cased (plans/class-divergence-drive/decisions.md D10); the survey and census still print it `diverged`.

entries.scope: svg-conformance class ledger (embedded {{ }} payload bytes -- declared divergence, DIVERGENCES.md, D9)
entries.reason: Embedded `{{ ... }}` sub-diagram payload bytes: the jar rasterises the nested diagram and emits `<image xlink:href="data:image/png;base64,...">` (`EmbeddedDiagram.java:165-195`); this port renders the nested source recursively with its own `renderSync` and emits the SVG source as `data:image/svg+xml;base64` (DIVERGENCES.md, `Embedded {{ }} sub-diagrams -- SVG source, not a re-encoded raster (deliberate, CDD T27)`; plans/class-divergence-drive/decisions.md D9). The `<image>` element, its position and its width/height are the target and are compared; only the href payload is declared. compare.ts already ignores data: hrefs, so this entry documents the declaration rather than excusing a verdict.
entries.surveyBlind: tests/oracle/svg-conformance/compare.ts:374 exempts <image> xlink:href bytes (DIVERGENCES.md, sprite and img rasters pass-through), so the survey reports this fixture conformant while the accepted PNG-vs-SVG payload divergence stands.

entries.scope: svg-conformance class ledger (error page version/source identity -- cdd4 D6)
entries.reason: Error-page identity lines only. The fixture's jar output is PlantUML's syntax-error page, and after class-divergence-drive-3 T29 every number on it is exact except the two identity strings and their textLength: the version banner (jar `PlantUML version $version$ / $git.commit.id$`, ours `plantuml-ts version 0.1.0 / unknown`) and the source-name line (jar `[From in.puml (line N) ]`, ours `[From string (line N) ]`, because the port renders from a string, not a file). Re-verified 2026-09-26 (cdd4 T1) with render-diff: structural=4, numeric=0, all four on those two <text> elements. Evidence: plans/class-divergence-drive-3/diagnosis/C.md (C-17, C-18). Signed by the maintainer 2026-09-26 (cdd4 D6).

entries.scope: svg-conformance class ledger (upstream crash page -- cdd4 D6)
entries.reason: The jar's output for this fixture is a CRASH page, not a diagram: graphviz 16.1.0 loses both `sh0006->sh0008` edges (`lost ... edge`), so `SvekEdge.getStartContactPoint()` is null, and `groupInheritance 2` wraps A in `EntityImageProtected`, whose `Neighborhood.drawU` sametail loop feeds the null point into `intersection` and throws a NullPointerException (`Neighborhood.java:80`, `:151`). The port draws the diagram. Precedent: DIVERGENCES.md, upstream crashes (deliberate). Re-verified 2026-09-26 (cdd4 T1): the jar in.svg is the QR-code error page (childCount 50 vs 7). Evidence: plans/class-divergence-drive-3/diagnosis/E3.md#zuduxu-90-kosi876 (E3-A). Signed by the maintainer 2026-09-26 (cdd4 D6).

entries.scope: svg-conformance class ledger (dot-engine known divergence A3 -- cdd4 D6)
entries.reason: One flat labelled `minlen=0` edge (`sh0006->sh0007`) routes around the mirrored side of its label box. docs/graphviz-issues/23 / TRACKER 23: dot-engine accepted this as an instance of its docs/known-divergences.md A3 (spline-routing tie-break). A symmetric label corridor makes the two candidate split corners an exact tie, and C graphviz and the port resolve the tie on floating-point noise, so there is no upstream fix to wait for. Re-verified 2026-09-26 (cdd4 T1) on dot-engine 1.6.1: render-diff structural=0, numeric=23, all on that edge's path and arrowhead polygon (max Δ16.06, label side mirrored); every other element exact. Signed by the maintainer 2026-09-26 (cdd4 D6).

retired.scope: svg-conformance class golden ratchet (edge spline control points)
retired.reason: ORIGINAL (2026-08-08): The jar's edge-spline control points are quantized to 2 decimals; ours carry full precision, and clipping amplifies the difference into ~0.0097 at the trimmed end -- just over the harness's 0.01 tolerance. The quantization is Smetana's, not ours: on the jar's own svek-1.dot our engine returns exactly what real graphviz 15.1.1 returns. Smetana is a transpile of graphviz 2.38 and is years out of date; the maintainer's decision is that this port does NOT chase compatibility with it, so the cause is moot and our value is the better one.
retired.retiredReason: Withdrawn on two independent grounds, both measured. (1) THE PREMISE WAS FALSE. ~0.0097 is INSIDE the 0.01 band, not over it. Two artifacts stacked to make it fail anyway: 3-decimal SVG emission rounds 75.1940275463084 and 75.1843 apart to exactly 0.010, and the comparator's `Math.abs(a-b) > tolerance` then rejected that because IEEE-754 yields 0.010000000000005116 for the subtraction. The second is a harness defect, fixed in compare.ts#exceedsTolerance; the fixture now measures 0 diffs and is re-pinned. It was never outside the declared conformance band. (2) THE STATED CAUSE WAS WRONG. The quantization is not Smetana's. This fixture never touches Smetana -- it has a svek-1.dot, and Smetana paths emit none. svek/DotStringFactory.java:316 calls create(skinParam, dotString, "svg"), and GraphvizRuntimeEnvironment#create dispatches to GraphvizLinux, the external dot binary; PlantUML then scrapes that SVG TEXT. `dot -Tsvg` prints coordinates with 2 decimals, and real graphviz 15.1.1 on this fixture's own svek-1.dot emits M24.58,-107.74C24.58,-90.06 24.58,-65.87 24.58,-48.21 -- reproducing every jar value including the 24.58 the original diagnosis could not place. dot-engine's full-precision points rounded to 2dp are bit-identical to that output at all four control points, so the two engines AGREE and the difference is purely serialization precision. It therefore will NOT disappear when the jar updates graphviz. The 'we don't chase a 2.38 transpile' rationale does not apply to this fixture at all.
